name: antriksh-plugins
description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: architect
plugins.description: Software architecture toolkit. /architect:design proposes 2-3 contrasting designs for a problem with C4 diagrams, grounded in the architecture literature and industry precedent. /architect:xray reverse-engineers an existing repository into an HTML case study: patterns, key design decisions and why, and how the architecture evolved.

plugins.name: hotspots
plugins.description: Find and prioritise tech debt. /hotspots:map measures churn and complexity from git history and produces an HTML report: a heat map of the codebase, a diagnosis of each top hotspot with a recommended fix, hidden coupling between files, and an ordered plan.
